title: Menu
description: Luna Café's menu: specialty coffee, cold drinks and homemade cakes, with prices.

props.title: What we serve
props.text: Every coffee is made with beans we roast ourselves. Plant-based milk (oat, almond or soy) comes at no extra cost.

items.name: Espresso
items.description: Short and intense, with notes of dark chocolate and caramel.

items.name: Cappuccino
items.description: A double espresso with silky steamed milk, in a 6 oz cup.

items.name: Cold brew
items.description: Steeped cold for 18 hours and served over ice. Refreshing, with a gentle sweetness.

items.name: V60 pour-over
items.description: Filter coffee brewed by hand, with the beans of the week.

items.name: Beans to take home
items.description: A half-pound bag, whole or ground while you wait. [Order a bag](/contact).

props.title: From the oven
props.subtitle: Baked here every morning, until they're gone.

items.name: Carrot cake
items.description: With walnuts, cinnamon and cream cheese frosting.

items.name: Butter croissant
items.description: Crisp on the outside, soft on the inside.

items.name: Blueberry muffin
items.description: Light and fluffy, with whole blueberries and a hint of lemon.
